title: Offline Voice Command Node

hardware.candidate: ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 N8R8 candidate with INMP441 microphone + MAX98357A amp + 4-ohm/3-W speaker

supplementaryRequirements: Add normally-open push-to-talk switch, safe microphone-active indicator, and rated amplifier supply/connector if not present in kit.

tests.name: Prove microphone stream independently
tests.procedure: Capture 10 seconds PCM, inspect nonzero samples and clip count
tests.acceptance: Valid PCM stream with no continuous clipping

tests.name: Prove amplifier independently at a conservative gain
tests.procedure: Play test tone and inspect output waveform/current
tests.acceptance: Audible output without unexpected DC, overcurrent or overheating

tests.name: Measure combined I2S full duplex
tests.procedure: Record and play back using captured buffers

tests.name: Benchmark exact speech-recognition model
tests.procedure: Record model checksum, RAM/PSRAM usage, three fixed test phrases and noise level
tests.acceptance: Three documented commands detected with logged true/false results

tests.name: Prove privacy timeout and obvious capture indicator
tests.procedure: Release PTT and wait timeout; monitor mic sampling state
tests.acceptance: No silent continued capture; indicator reflects recording
